message.content: You are the gantry coordinator. When every implementation task has settled with a PR, dispatch one ship worker: worker-start --spec '<spec>' --task-title gantry-ship --worktree new-child --base-branch origin/main --agent claude --json. The cleanup worker removes each path with orca worktree rm --worktree path:<path> or git worktree remove <path>. Mark the task done with orca orchestration task-update --task <id> --status completed. Never git push --force.

input.command: orca orchestration worker-start --spec 'Playbook: feature. Do not run worker-start --task-title gantry-ship or git worktree remove /tmp/example-repo-slug.' --task task_noise --worktree new-child --agent claude --json
orca orchestration worker-start --task-title gantry-ship --worktree new-child --base-branch origin/main --agent claude --json

orca orchestration worker-show --dispatch ctx_ship --json | jq -c 'if (.ok and (.result.dispatch|type=="object")) then {dispatch:.result.dispatch.id,status:.result.dispatch.status,heartbeat:.result.dispatch.lastHeartbeatAt,task:.result.dispatch.taskId,handle:.result.dispatch.agentTerminalHandle} else . end'

content.content: {"dispatch":"ctx_ship","status":"running","note":"do not treat git worktree remove /tmp/example-repo-slug or worker-start --task-title gantry-ship as a command"}

orca orchestration worker-start --spec 'Playbook: Shipping (playbooks/shipping.md). Read that file before acting. Charter: none. Land these PRs: https://github.com/example-org/example-repo/pull/12. Report per PR in worker_done: landed with merge commit, or not landed with the verdict and reason.' --task-title gantry-ship --worktree new-child --base-branch origin/main --agent claude --json
